'When not to use' lists three specific, honest failure modes: witness must be chosen/transformed in a way accessors cannot express; single use makes the indirection not worth it; a proof that genuinely needs to unfold. Minor imprecision: avoid_when says avoid when the witness is 'chosen or transformed' while the example's own symm (lines 84-87) does transform the witness, but that transformation is itself an accessor lemma, so the 'in a way the accessors cannot express' qualifier already scopes it correctly.
